126750.description:
Tetsu is just an average teacher looking out for his childhood best friend, Shima, who is actually a vampire. To an outsider, they are merely teacher and student. Since Shima is a vampire, he has to drink blood to appease his hunger. Usually, small animals such as cats and pigeons suffice, but Shima's feelings of love and jealousy make him crave for Tetsu's blood. The latter readily gives his blood and makes Shima promise to drink blood only from him. Things get more complicated as Shima's vampire instincts get stronger.

(Source: Futekiya)

126751.description:
Kouji is a catfisher under the name 'Ako' online. He pretends to be a sweet princess to seduce men online and stand them up once he gets bored. That is until he meets his match, Nuts, his latest victim. Now, Kouji finds the tables turned as Nuts finds out his real identity and requests Kouji to go with him to a hotel. Unable to refuse, Kouji agrees. But it seems Nuts has other plans, and it involves exposing more than Kouji's cute side that he hides underneath his aloofness.

Risuka had left the Kingdom of Magic through the Gate, chasing after her father, a great mage called both "a God" and "a Demon." An unpredictable and unchained magical tale!

One morning, HARUHI wakes up to find that she's married to an old man she doesn't know!? Haruhi works as a heavy machinery operator at a construction site full of men.One night, Haruhi meets a middle-aged man with grey hair at a pub, and submits a marriage certificate under the influence of alcohol. Because he has nine tails, Hinata's even an outcast in his own pack and he decides to wants to die. But, instead of killing him, Kyouya says, "It's time for our honeymoon" and takes him prisoner...

This is a dramatic inhuman story between an arrogant, self-centered wolf and a downtrodden yet very pretty and submissive fox.

“Um, who is that story about?”

This is the story of an earl’s daughter, who will have everything she has to do explained the day after tomorrow, and who, after all, sorts of troubles, tries to somehow attain happiness in the battlefield of women called the inner palace.

(Source: Arian Rose, translated)
synonyms: The Inner Palace Tale of a Villainess Noble Girl

126854.description:
Rookie hospital cook Jeong-Dong always wished he could do more for the patients who ate his food. But he never imagined the Roman goddess Ceres would answer his prayers, or that she'd name him her priest on earth! Now, Jeong-Dong's noble new mission is to bless people with his cooking and gather enough good karma to restore Ceres's powers. As he works miracles with his dishes, he's more inspired than ever in his journey to become a world-reknowned chef. What's troubling, though, is that the goddess won't tell him why she needs all the power she can get. Meanwhile, a mysterious enemy inches ever closer to the duo... will Jeong-Dong's cooking and Ceres' divine powers be enough to brave the storm that lies ahead?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

title.native: ハイスクール・ローレライ 運命のひと耳惚れ
title.romaji: High School Lorelei: Unmei no Hitomibore

synonyms: It Was Insanely Too Late to Incarnate!

title.romaji: Ososugita Isekai Tensei: Jinrui wo Horoboshita Maou desu kedo Yokattara Uchi de Hatarakimasen ka?

title.native: だから俺は魔力供給を断れない
title.romaji: Dakara Ore wa Maryoku Kyoukyuu wo Kotowarenai

126858.description:
When her family is overthrown in a coup d'état, Princess Mayuka is sent to Earth to recharge the Ultimate Weapon. After studying the mating behaviors of Earthlings, she decides to enlist the help of one of her research subjects, college student Yoshizumi, but crash-lands on his roof. Taken hostage and shot with her own gun by Yoshizumi, she is brainwashed into thinking she is his younger sister. Fortunately, Yoshizumi grows fond of Mayuka and decides to help her with her mission: to awaken the powers of Akiho--the red-haired, green-eyed, appetite-driven Ultimate Weapon--using "primitive stimulation".

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 姫さま、世界滅ぶからごはん食べ行きますよ！
title.romaji: Hime-sama, Sekai Horobu kara Gohan Tabe Ikimasu yo!

title.native: おた☆こい シリーズ

126862.description: Kazuho is a hardcore UFO otaku, much to the chagrin of his stepbrother Haruichi. But after getting roped into Kazuho's antics, Haruichi feels jealous when the UFO Research Club start getting involved too!

title.native: 俺の義兄がUFO呼ぼうとしてるんですけど
title.romaji: Ore no Gikei ga UFO Yobou to Shiterun Desu kedo

title.native: 人生がより散らかる！深刻お悩み相談室
title.romaji: Jinsei ga Yori Chirakaru! Shinkoku Onayami Soudanshitsu

126868.description: A short story about baseball. It is the third short story published to celebrate the 40th anniversary of the Weekly Big Comics Spirits.

title.native: ユーキャンドゥーイット?
キョーダイシャッフル

126899.description:
Swelling emotions drawing ever closer from out of the distance. ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

126900.description: There is a war going on and two men are stuck in prison cells and keep each other company with conversation.

126902.description:
Du-Sik is in a bind. After making off with the takings from the gay bar where he worked, he seeks refuge in a small, coastal town. As his funds dwindle, he desperately needs a way to make ends meet. Still, a boy’s gotta eat! So he dives into a clam house to satisfy his cravings. But with no money to pay, he dashes off leaving Ju-Ha, the server, to foot the bill. Later on, when Du-Sik returns to pay his debt, he’s greeted by a sordid scene that offers a tantalizing glimpse of the solution to his money problems. For within Ju-Ha's beautiful shell lies a secret treasure waiting to be drawn out. And Du-Sik is just the man to do it.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.

126903.description: Nagisa has just recently transformed from being a human to a mermaid and is easing into the transition of living in the ocean. But when she crashes into a research submarine, she loses her memory and is brought on board the Sogei. It turns out that her love interest from when she was still human, Osanai, is on board and he tries to keep his past with Nagisa a secret from everyone else. Her mermaid friend, Tsunami, goes on a rescue mission to find Nagisa and warn her that since she just transformed into a mermaid, if she doesn’t speak for an hour, she turns back into a human and her life expectancy will dramatically drop!

126904.description:
Cha Hyeon-Seong used to have it all: incredible powers, a promising future as a hero, and a sweet girlfriend. Then he lost his powers, became a lowly manager for other heroes, and got dumped. At the peak of his despair, Hyeon-Seong crosses paths with Son Ga-Yeong, a former hero who also fell from grace. After a passionate night together, they discover that, with a little extra spunk, Hyeon-Seong might have the power to be the greatest hero manager of all. Now it’s time for him to get it up and go to work!

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ヒーローのマネージャー

126906.description: Billions of years after an advanced human civilization was destroyed by aliens, twelve direct descendants of the civilization's warriors called "Sazers" have their powers awakened and form four tribes: Fire, Wind, Earth and Water. At first, they wage war on each other, but after learning the truth of their ancestry, the GranSazer tribes unite to protect Earth from the alien forces bent on once again extinguishing all life on the planet.

title.native: 超星神グランセイザー
リリィガ様とお呼び！～新人女幹部研修中～
title.romaji: Liliyga-sama to Oyobi!: Shinjin Onna Kanbu Kenshuuchuu

126919.description: Bale Beresford serves as a personal agent to the Pope of the Papal Kingdom of Apostolo. Having finished his previous mission, his next assignment is to monitor and attend to Luna, a potential candidate to become the Holy Maiden. Will he handle this mission the same as the others, or will something in him change?

title.native: 聖女様を甘やかしたい！ただし勇者、お前はダメだ
title.romaji: Seijo-sama wo Amayakashitai! Tadashi Yuusha, Omae wa Dame da

126920.description: Rin, a young angel (presumed female, but angels don’t have clear genders) falls in love with a young human girl, Miku. However, their love is considered taboo, and so, Rin makes a deal with the devil to be reborn as the human boy, Len, in order to be with Miku. However, their happiness together is short-lived, and even that soon ends in tragedy.

126922.description: Suzuki is an unpopular erotic manga artist whose latest series had just gotten axed. Depressed, he prayed at a shrine for a chance for people to appreciate his work, and he was suddenly sent to a fantastical kingdom. When the king saw Suzuki's books, he was so impressed that he hired Suzuki to be the royal mangaka, and hailed Suzuki as the savior of the kingdom…!?
synonyms: 非主流勇者的異世界聖經

title.native: はぐれ勇者の異世界バイブル
はぐれ勇者の異世界バイブル

The Seven Witches and Legatus of Cinderella Sky

title.native: 七人の魔女と灰被りの空の御剣者 (レガトゥス)
title.romaji: Shichinin no Majo to Haikaburi no Sora no Legatus

126925.description:
Mia grew up poor in her small town. Though she worked hard for her keep, a life of stitching clothes could never afford her the finer things. One day, while browsing a jewelry store, she chances upon a beautiful red brooch. It's a luxury she could never afford with ten lifetimes' worth of income. Even so, a strange darkness begins to take over the child as she covets a life beyond her means.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.native: ハートビートシャウト

126927.description:
Xu Sheng x Tang Zhi Using all of one's brain power and pawning away one's life.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

126928.description:
The family elders, fighting for the right to exploit the mines, sent someone to crush his dantian, and Xuan became an abandoned son of the Ye family. However, he accidentally entered the Tower of Boundless Hell because of his mother's bleeding ring and was instructed by a mysterious woman to cultivate the Dao of the sword, which no one had ever cultivated before.

With the help of the mysterious woman, could Ye Xuan become the strongest swordsman in the realm of the heavens?

126929.description:
Misaki, who likes idols and thus became an idol.
Kousuke, who goes his own way and hopes to be liked by many people.

One day, a producer approached Misaki saying “Let’s grow our feelings together” and forced himself on him, thus Misaki cried to Kousuke to save him. Because of this, the two’s relationship has become awkward. Two people who were originally full of hopes and dreams, encircled by desires and lies, what will they find in the end?

126930.description:
During summer break in elementary school, Ryusei sees his sleeping brother get kissed by Hide, his brother's best friend. At his brother's wedding, he is reunited with Hide. He notices that Hide still looks at his brother with the same eyes as before, but at the same time he starts to fall for Hide's kindness and gentleness...

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Kore kara no Koi no Hanashi wo Shiyou

title.native: これからの恋の話をしよう
title.romaji: Korekara no Koi no Hanashi wo Shiyou

126931.description:
Chitose Yuzumoto receives a letter telling him to meet the sender in front of the library. He thinks he's waiting for a cute girl, but the person who comes is Riku Hidaka, the ex-captain of the baseball team!! While Chitose tries to hide his shock, Riku asks him to help him make memories for his last year of high school by going out with him for just two weeks. The two start off almost as though they were just really good friends, but soon, Chitose notices some feelings stirring up in him...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: その彼氏、期間限定につき

126933.description:
An anthology featuring a variety of stories with girl x girl relationships, with a focus on Heroine x Villainess! Heroines and villainesses, maids and villainesses...5 stories featuring relationships between girls and their bonds can be found in this anthology. A collection of stories that were published on Shousetsuka ni Narou! All have happy endings!

2. Konyaku Haki sareta Ojou-sama ga Taihen Sou na node Tasuke ni Hairimashita (婚約破棄されたお嬢様が大変そうなので助けに入りました, Milady Looked Extremely Troubled When Her Engagement was Annulled, so I Stepped In to Help Her) [Ooba Soto x Ringoame Tsuin]

I Need To Do My Best To Stop It! ...But I Was The Reason Behind It...) [Wani x naturalsoft] I thought I could prevent the condemnation event from happening by becoming the villainess's best friend!

4. Akuyaku Reijou to no Yuujou Route (悪役令嬢との友情ルート, My Friendship Route With the Villainess) [Hoshina x Taikoban]

title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou desu ga, Heroine ni Kouryaku Saretemasu wa!? Anthology Comic

126934.description:
Gunji Arata is a best-selling novelist who is fashionable, loves cats, and is good at teasing. A new editor, Suzumori, came to receive his new manuscript. "Thank you for your hard work, Sensei. I received the manuscript!!" "Suzumori-kun, your expression looks good. This is... it looks like it's going to be good."

However, Gunji-sensei wasn't writing the manuscript...?! A cool uncle comedy presented by Tajima from "Wednesday Lunch Trip"!

title.native: 群司先生の密かな楽しみ

126936.description: Chiisaku Furikabutte, lit. “Small Windup”, was published in Afternoon between the tankobon publications of volumes 15 and 16 and during the 2011 hiatus, and it is a series of specials about the lives of Oofuri characters.

126937.description:
On the Tianwu Continent, the strong commands the weak. The young master of the Feng family Feng Hao, owns a unique physique but was mistakenly thought to be a failure in cultivation. He was chastised and humiliated constantly because of that. A chance meeting transformed him completely and ultimately altered his fate. He contoured his body with rare gems and eventually achieved invincibility. He was set on the path to conquering the void and rampaging through the universe!

(Source: BiliBili Comics)

126938.description: When Qin Lie realized that he could only protect himself with power, he resolutely stepped onto the path to becoming an Immortal. He used blood to write an everlasting legend, demons and deities, a mortal transcending, outside the three realms, all could be seen!
synonyms: Trample On The River Of Immortality

126939.description:
He had been missing for eight years. But no one realized that he had traveled to another world and cultivated for eight thousand years! After returning to earth, he looked for his sister, but no one thought that he would overturn all the major forces on the earth at the same time! He kidnapped the rich girl, but nobody would've expected that he'd wipe out her fiancee, too. He can fight hand-to-hand or brew up potions. Anyone who messes with him... will be doomed to eternal damnation!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Return to Earth to Be a God

126941.description:
A 21st century top-class assassin travels back in time one day to find that she's been transformed into the Second Miss of the Duanmu Family, one of the five great aristocratic families of the Xuanyuan Dynasty. But, this Second Miss was naturally useless, obsessed with men and a mother out of wedlock! Fine, since she was there already, then she should live coolly. When she appeared in front of everyone with her genius son, she was no longer "her". She wandered Jianghu with her son, killing everyone that got in the way. How would she survive in this chaotic world? And, out of all the handsome men that followed by her side, which one was her child's father? Finally, who would win her heart?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Tiancai Baobei De Fuhei Di Niang

126942.description: A grown-up and a very intelligent child pair up as detectives to resolve a case of murder!

title.native: テイラーとクリスの事件簿

126943.description:
Apparel designer Himari enjoys working from home more and more, because she can order all sorts of delicious food delivered to her home!

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

126944.description:
Though she comes from a rich family, Ga-Bin is a bullied loner at school. That doesn't mean she puts up with bullying from other students, though -- Ga-Bin is infamous for her fierce personality. Worried about Ga-Bin's well-being, her family secretly offers Tae-Ung $500,000 to transfer schools and act as her bodyguard. Will Tae-Ung be able to protect her from the school bullies, all while keeping his identity hidden from Ga-Bin and the other students?

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: King of Idol: School of the Rose King

title.native: キング・オブ・アイドル 薔薇王の学園
title.romaji: King of Idol: Baraou no Gakuen

126946.description:
Jun-Ung, an unemployed college graduate, slips into a coma when he accidentally falls off of a bridge. While he's in a comatose state, he gets an offer from the crisis response team of the underworld company Flashback to temporarily join their team. If he accepts this offer, he could wake up early from the coma and even get rid of the karma from his past life that’s been holding him back from getting jobs! He’s got nothing better to do tomorrow, so it’s a beautiful day to save lives… with these grim reapers!!

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

synonyms: Itsumo Dokodemo Nin Nin Ninja, Itsudokoninnin

title.native: いつもどこでも忍²ニンジャ
骸骨ナイフでジャンプ
僕にお月様を見せないで
かてきょーぱらだいす! ~小悪魔3人とキャッキャウフフの夏休み~
title.romaji: Katekyo Paradise! Koakuma 3-nin to Kyakkyaufufu no Natsuyasumi

126953.description:
Dragoness, Mystic Warrior, Elf, Mandragora, Thief, Slime Girl... to save the world the hero challenges each vixen of evil! (and gets gleefully r*ped by her when he loses)

An epic, erotic fantasy world. He is the naively driven hero who wants to vanquish villainy at its source: the Dragon inhabiting historic ruins! It's a quest of many meetings, from normal to protective monster girls, and for some reason they're all sexual...

Can he rise to victory? Will he protect the peace of the world!?

Or will he falter, fail and die in a glorious blaze of sex...?

(Source: dlsite, Translated)

title.native: 犯され勇者～凛々しく世界を救うハズだったボク…～
title.romaji: Okasare Yuusha: Ririshiku Sekai wo Sukuu Hazu Datta Boku...

title.romaji: Steal!!: Saikyou no Last Number to Saikyou no Clears

title.native: 俺のニオイは発情スイッチ
title.romaji: Ore no Nioi wa Hatsujou Switch

126959.description: A dialogue-less story about a man who looks for water to finish his painting.
synonyms: ウォータークライシス

126960.description:
Jin-Ho Kim is an intern who is filled with dreams of becoming a full-time employee after finding a job at a large company. However, what he got was a special "education" for new recruits from his beautiful boss.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

126961.description:
A group of high school students visits a rural village in the mountains to learn to live like farmers. But it seems like this village never existed before they arrived. And when mysterious events begin to happen, they start to wonder if any of them will make it out alive…

(Source: Mangamo)

126962.description:
The prominent Kamimura family treasures all of their talented descendants. But this isn't the case for Nio, the only omega in the Kamimuras' long unbroken line of alphas. When the death of his brother Reo and sister-in-law Ruri forces Nio back to the house he left behind, their newly orphaned sons remind Nio of his past - especially the older brother Suou, who inherited Nio's brother's abilities despite not sharing any of his blood. What happens when these unlikely almost-relatives begin a new life together?

(Source : Futekiya)
synonyms: How to Grow α to Be in Love
How to Grow Alpha to Be in Love

title.english: How To Raise an Alpha You Love
title.native: 恋するアルファの育て方

126963.description:
Asahi wants nothing more than to be an idol, and when he's chosen as the latest member of boyband B-Marks he's over the moon. Except for one little detail; Asahi is an omega, and one of the other members, Madoka, is an alpha. Insisting on staying unmated to remain loyal to their fanbase, Asahi agrees to a "friends with benefits" arrangement to appease their hormonal urges without commitment. At least, that's what he intends...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)
synonyms: Heat x Beat -พันธนาการรักมัดใจนายไอดอล-

title.english: Heat x Beat: I May Be an Omega, but I'm Going to Be an Idol!
title.native: Heat×Beat～オメガだけどアイドル始めました～
title.romaji: Heat x Beat: Omega Dakedo Idol Hajimemashita

126964.description:
Mu Haiwei, a homebody with a short height and bad personality who longs for romantic love, suddenly encounters a miraculous frog one day, which brings dramatic change to her life. After the appearance of the miraculous frog, who is the man who shows up constantly? What does the frog bring to her? And who is the real prince for Mu Haiwei? Now the goddess of love favors Mu Haiwei - is it an affair of the previous life, or merely longing for love? Will Mu Haiwei be together with her beloved?

(Source: Webcomics)

126965.description:
Wei Yanzi and Gu Yiliang burst onto the acting scene together, igniting a rivalry fueled by their shared debut. But while Gu Yiliang dazzles with his acting prowess and idol-worthy looks, Wei Yanzi finds himself in the shadow with only his striking appearance to boast. Amid the barrage of online hate from Gu Yiliang’s fervent admirers, Wei Yanzi’s patience wears thin.

When Wei Yanzi stumbles upon an online community totally convinced there’s a romantic entanglement between the two actors, he is initially shocked but soon finds solace in their speculation as he immerses himself in their discussions.

Though their relationship is purely professional, Wei Yanzi can’t shake the growing sense that maybe the shippers are onto something. As he spends more time with Gu Yiliang, lines blur, and Wei Yanzi begins to wonder if there might, after all, be truth behind the fan-fueled fantasies!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Chapter count includes 7 extra chapters.
synonyms: I Ship My Adversary X Me
Wo Ke le Duijia x Wo de CP
エゴサしたらライバル×俺の二次創作にハマりました

title.english: I Ship My Rival x Me

126966.description:
As an aspiring actress, Wanwan Tang knows how to fake her feelings. But when it comes to superhot, superstar, actor Jian Ning she can’t hide her true feelings about him: she hates his guts! Whether sabotaging Wanwan’s lines or outright ignoring her existence, Jian has been nothing but rude to her. Yet, much like the movies they star in, there’s more to Jian behind the scenes. Is he really this rude? Or is it all just an act?

(Source: Tapas)

126967.description:
Zhanhao is a dedicated cultivator who wishes to reach the top spiritual level before he turns 18. But all cultivators know that the road to leveling up is filled with ups and downs. Zhanhao's challenge comes one day when his father goes missing and he finds himself in "Mystery Land", where he can complete missions to gain special power to break through, but if he fails a mission, the punishment is death.

(Source: WebComics)

126968.description: Cecile lost her entire inheritance to her cousin as a result of not being a male heir. Three men then begin to appear in her life: the Duke of Marmontel, who has obtained wealth and power as a branch member of the royal family; the young and handsome Count Rohan, who has come to France from England; and Azrael, the demon who covets her soul. The quick-witted Cecile, with her ability to grasp others' desires, thus begins to use the three men to get what she wants. And somewhere along the way, confusing Cecile is memories of her previous life, memories that she slowly recovers...

126969.description: A non-fiction diary-style manga sent by the girl avatar Niwasaki Anna, centering on kitchen and garden stories.

126970.description:
The MC Ukeru is a completely normal student. One day, he is caught by some men in black and sold off in an underground auction in an unknown place. As the highest bid was placed, he heard a voice: "3 million!" Will the MC be able to protect his butt from all the Mr. Perfects that keep coming at him one after the other?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

My best friend betrayed me! Born from a low-ranking noble family, Angela grew to be renowned for her beauty and grace, becoming the prized angel of society, all with my enthusiastic support. Yet beneath that glitz and polish, she was simply... evil. She used me and had me killed out of sheer spite in her quest to become the empire’s greatest woman. Kunou was thinking how perfect prey he was and attempted to approach him but...The supposed target is a total bottom?! He got wrung dry instead? This is bad! How will Kunou deal with this?

126974.description:
One day, the overworked researcher Koki discovers a “dog” lying unconscious at the foot of his apartment complex and decides to bring it home. The next day, Koki wakes up to an unknown man in his apartment! Is he a burglar?! Amidst Koki’s panic, the man transforms into the “dog” he found last night and starts talking…! “Koki, I’m the dog you saved! Thank you, you’re really kind!” Thus starts the duo’s life in the shared apartment as pet(?) and owner…?! A loving story about the lives of a handsome human-transforming dog and a fussy scientist under one roof!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Shirato has always had terrible luck, even with the simplest things. When it seems that he might have a bit of luck going to his usual ramen place, it's stumped by the bawling, but very handsome person sitting beside him. Pitying the poor guy, Shirato offers him his handkerchief to comfort him. Turns out, the handsome person was Tatsuki Kurose, a famous actor and with his presence, it seems that Shirato's fortune has gotten better. But when one night reveals that Tatsuki's feelings for Shirato goes beyond friendship, Shirato's not sure if his terrible luck has gotten worse. Did it?

Aliens with extraordinarily advanced scientific powers are for some reason interested only in Japan and no other countries on earth, and let the spacecraft wait over Sagami Bay. 126983.description:
When Fumika arrives at the company she's supposed to start working at, she finds out... it's gone bankrupt!? Stuck without anywhere to go, she's helped by a suspicious man called Yabe, who then tells her she's going to work as a miko to pay him back.

126985.description: Soo Ah gave up her dream of becoming an artist due to her parents' opposition, Jade came to Korea to find her mother who had never seen her face since her father's death. She works as Butler at the Yuchae School, a noble school attended by Soo Ah. Looking for traces of her mother, Jade meets Soo Ah, who hangs on her dreams, helping her out, the developing feelings of love.

126986.description:
Hae-Jun Go, who ran from home, and Eun-Yeong Baek, the problem child who lives in a tent. These two, who met under terrible circumstances, are forced to live together in an abandoned dormitory. This is a story of difficult growth between two people who hate both the dorm and each other.

(Source: Naver, translated)

126987.description:
Best friends, household pet, or just charity case? Hayoon has no idea what she is to Minju after all these years. She's grateful Minju's family took her in despite her being nothing but a lowly recessive omega, but her relationship with Minju sure is confusing. Minju does seem to like her, whispering sweet nothings in her ear and helping her out when she's in her heat, but who can tell? Ever the stereotypical rich alpha, Hayoon knows for a fact that Minju gets bored easily, that she loses all interest once she gets what she wants. Unable to tear herself away from Minju's grip, Hayoon unwillingly comes to harbor affection, albeit spiteful affection, for her friend...

(Source: Lezhin US)

126989.description:
It was supposed to be the happiest day of Satoru's life - until his bride left him at the altar for another woman! As he struggles to get his life back in order, it's a good thing his old friend Daichi's always there to look out for him - but is friendship really the only reason why Daichi's keeping him here? Or had Satoru's happiness been right beside him all along?

(Source : Futekiya)

Taeha Oh loves to write smutty BL stories online. Why? 'Cause it's fun. Though he insists he's definitely not gay himself. But will things change after a surprise reunion sparks something inside of him…?

126995.description:
Louis, a captain of the 2nd Guard, has been on the hunt. A hunt for the serial killer who has thrown the capital into a state of chaos for months. Having run himself ragged attempting to come up with a suspect, he ends up in the hospital. What was thought to be a simple case of being overworked, has turned out to be something else. Louis is four months pregnant. But that could only happen if a man is impregnated by one with strong royal ancestry. Four months ago was the date of the imperial ball and also when these murders started happening… But Louis can’t remember a thing… Who is behind these murders and just who the hell did he spend the night with the night of the ball?

(Source: Lezhin US)

126996.description: Emperor Lucardis, the dragon’s heir and guardian of the empire, suddenly visits Dyke, a retired knight who lived in peace with his daughter in a rural village after the war. There was a deep relationship between the two, but something seems to have happened! Meanwhile, the wheel of fate begins to flow in a new direction. A bittersweet and a little sexy love story between the young and charming wizard, Emperor Lucardis, and the slightly scary but upright knight, Dyke.
